label: lipolysis
definition: A metabolism in which a microorganism hydrolyzes triacylglycerols into fatty acids and glycerol through lipase-catalyzed ester cleavage.
observations: Microbial triacylglycerol hydrolysis trait; absent from live METPO except for METPO:1000175 obsolete lipolysis and distinct from lipase molecular function activity captured by GO:0016298.
